resources.string: Enroll this phone using a one-time pairing QR or bundle from the VAJRA console. Private keys remain inside Android Keystore.
Cryptographic zero-trust mesh protecting this Android endpoint with hardware-bound keys, signed heartbeats, and verified recovery controls.
Open the VAJRA console on your trusted computer, select Connect Device, and scan the pairing QR code shown on screen.
VAJRA requires camera access solely to scan pairing QR codes. No photos or video are recorded or transmitted.
Allow camera access to scan the QR code, or paste the pairing bundle directly from your clipboard.
Server URL, enrollment token, device ID, and challenge nonce are required.

This device is enrolled with a non-exportable ECDSA P-256 key in Android Keystore. Background telemetry and command checks are active.
Server URL must start with https:// (or http:// for local loopback development).
Removes the local Android Keystore key, cancels background workers, and clears local pairing metadata. Also revoke the device in the VAJRA web console if it remains listed.

VAJRA Companion protects endpoints you own using explicit, verifiable cryptographic controls.

Collected Telemetry:
• Device identifier & ECDSA P-256 public key fingerprint
• OS release, device model, and agent version
• Signed heartbeat connectivity & battery state (when available)
• Explicit command receipts (Device Status & Ring Alarm)

Never Collected:
• Keystrokes, SMS, contacts, photos, microphone audio, or camera recordings
• Continuous background GPS location tracking

Permissions Used:
• INTERNET — Signed communication with your configured VAJRA server
• CAMERA — Only during active QR pairing scan
• POST_NOTIFICATIONS — High-priority Find My Device ring alerts

You can disconnect and delete local Keystore keys anytime in Settings.
